scope: Closed known-declaration subset of anyType lax wildcards
namespaceConstraint: Builtin anyType namespace-any only; expanded names resolve against original closed global catalogs

rules.knownElement: Validate using actual global declaration/type/plan; preserve canonical handle
rules.knownAttribute: Validate actual global declaration/type/provided fixed value; retain owner path
rules.unknownElementOrAttribute: Unsupported; no governing declaration is fabricated
rules.missingGlobalAttribute: No attribute use exists on anyType: no required/default augmentation
rules.unknownUntypedFacts: Not implemented; current provider indexes every state declaration in its owned component ring

provenancePrerequisite.finding: Facts publication uses provider.components[state.Declaration] for every element and attribute
provenancePrerequisite.consequence: The known-declaration subset fits existing authority; unknown/declaration-absent lax nodes require a separate representation contract

guards: actual document depth/nodes/attributes bounded before recursive assessment
all local validation and ID tables before fact publication
known invalid data cannot be skipped or treated as an untyped string
source declaration components are reused, never invented for wildcard occurrences
